title: Guest Greeting Standard
summary: How every guest should be welcomed at Zura Spa.

steps.title: Make eye contact
steps.body: Acknowledge the guest within 10 seconds of arrival.

steps.title: Warm welcome
steps.body: Greet with a calm smile and introduce yourself by name.

steps.title: Offer assistance
steps.body: Confirm their booking and offer water or herbal tea.

remember: First impressions set the tone for the entire spa journey.
